title: File transfer over plaintext FTP (python)
description: python code opens a plain FTP connection (ftplib.FTP). FTP sends the password and the file bytes unencrypted, so anyone on the path reads both; the same call is also the usual delivery path for a stolen backup. This lexical rule flags the client; the reviewer confirms whether SFTP or FTPS is available.
remediation: Use SFTP or FTPS, for example paramiko SFTP over a verified host key, and disable plaintext FTP at the network edge so a future call fails loudly.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: cannot tell an internal, isolated FTP hop from one that crosses an untrusted network.
